page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz, paired with 16.0 GB of RAM. This configuration provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The single-core CPU performance is strong, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests, and average for Geekbench single-core. However, multi-core performance is weak, falling into the bottom 25% for stress-ng and bottom 10% for Geekbench multi-core. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with large-block write speeds categorized as poor at 12.61 GB/sec.

Given the high memory allocation relative to the low core count, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring moderate memory footprints without heavy parallel processing demands. It is suitable for lightweight database hosting, caching layers, and single-threaded application tasks. It is less suited for multi-threaded compilation, intensive database operations, or high-throughput web serving due to its lower multi-core and memory bandwidth benchmarks.
